item.title: [New] Defender for Cloud plan management moves into the Defender portal (public preview): plans become view-only in the Azure portal and migrated subscriptions bill in Defender Workload Units
item.description:
Who can switch Defender for Cloud plans off moves from Azure RBAC on subscriptions to Defender portal permissions; Azure Policy or IaC that sets plans through the Azure portal APIs may stop being the place of truth.

Azure · Before migrating a subscription, decide who in Defender unified RBAC may change plans, check that IaC or Azure Policy that sets pricing tiers still works, and model the DWU cost estimate.
